He follows the instructions. As far as general knowledge questions are concerned, we come to the conclusion that there are three types of powers:
matter, soul, and supreme soul. Now, if we enter the Bhagavad Gita or Vedic knowledge, then we will also
be able to understand that these three powers are dependent on the Supreme Personality of Godhead. The Supreme Being is God
is a partial expression. The Bhagavad Gita confirms that God, through his partial expression, maintains dominance over the entire
physical world. God is great, and He cannot be merely the obedient of the soul. Therefore, the complete expression of the Supreme Being, the Supreme Personality of Godhead, is not possible. By the soul,
the realization of the Supreme Soul is the beginning of self-realization, and by the progress of this self-realization,
a person becomes capable of experiencing God through intellect, through accepted scriptures, and mainly through divine grace.
Bhagavad Gita is the initial concept of Lord Shri Krishna, and
Srimad Bhagavat is the explanation of Isha Vidya after that. Therefore, if we remain steadfast in our resolve and
pray for the grace of the director of intellect residing in that body-like tree, who is seated with other birds in the form of birds,
as it is said in the Upanishads, then the information given in the Vedas will become clear to us, and then there will be no difficulty in understanding Lord Vasudeva. Therefore, a wise person
by such use of intellect, even after many births, takes refuge in the lotus feet of Vasudeva,
as it is confirmed in the Bhagavad Gita (7.19).

वे पिछले श्लोक में बता चुके हैं कि भक्तियोग की भव्य विधि के अतिरिक्त मोक्ष का कोई शुभ उपाय
नहीं है । भक्तों द्वारा विभिन्न विधियों यथा श्रवण, कीर्तन, स्मरण, पादसेवन, अर्चन, वन्दन, दास्य, सख्य
तथा आत्म-निवदेन से भक्तियोग का अभ्यास किया जाता है। ये नवों प्रामाणिक विधिर्यो हैं ओर
निष्ठावान भक्त इनमें से सभी या कुछ या केवल एक विधि द्वारा वांछित फल पा सकता है । किन्तु इनमें
से पहली विधि अर्थात्‌ श्रवण विधि भक्तियोग में सर्व-प्रमुख है । पर्याप्त तथा समुचित विधि से श्रवण
किये बिना, अन्य विधियों के अभ्यास से कोई प्रगति नहीं हो पाती और केवल श्रवण के लिए तो
समूचा वैदिक वाड्मय भरा पड़ा है, जिसे व्यासदेव जैसे भगवान्‌ के शक्त्यावेश अवतार ने संकलित
किया है। चूँकि यह सुनिश्चित हो चुका है कि भगवान्‌ प्रत्येक वस्तु के परमात्मा है, अतएव उनका
श्रवण तथा कीर्तन सर्वत्र एवं सदेव होना चाहिए। यह मनुष्य का विशिष्ठ कर्तव्य हे । जब मनुष्य
सर्वव्यापी भगवान्‌ के विषय में सुनना बन्द कर देता है, तो वह मानवनिर्मित यन्त्रो द्वारा प्रसारित कूडा-
करकट सुनने का अभ्यस्त बन जाता है। कोई यन्त्र बुरा नहीं है, क्योकि यन्त्र से मनुष्य भगवान्‌ के
विषय में सुन सकता है, किन्तु प्रच्छन्न कार्यो के लिए प्रयुक्त होने से यन्त्र मानव सभ्यता के स्तर में
त्वरित हास ला रहा है। यहाँ पर यह कहा गया है कि मनुष्य को सुनना अनिवार्य है, क्योकि
भगवद्गीता तथा श्रीमद्‌भागवत जैसे ग्रंथ इसी उदेश्य से लिखे गये हैँ । मनुष्यों के अतिरिक्त अन्य कोई
सजीव प्राणी ऐसे वैदिक ग्रंथों का श्रवण नहीं कर सकता। यदि मानव समाज वैदिक साहित्य का श्रवण
करे तो वह उन अपवित्र व्यक्तियों द्वारा उच्चरित अपवित्र शब्द-ध्वनि को नहीं सुन पायेगा, जो पूरे
समाज के स्तर को गिराने वाले हैँ । श्रवण कौ पुष्टि कीर्तन द्वारा होती है। जो व्यक्ति उचित स्रोत से
सुनता है, वह सर्वव्यापी भगवान्‌ के विषय में आश्वस्त हो जाता है और तब वह भगवान्‌ का गुणगान
करने के लिए प्रोत्साहित होता है। सभी बड़े-बड़े आचार्यो ने, यथा रामानुज, मध्व, चैतन्य, सरस्वती
ठाकुर ने, या कि अन्य देशों में मुहम्मद, ईसा तथा अन्योँ ने, कीर्तन द्वारा सदैव तथा सर्वत्र भगवान्‌ का
यशोगान किया है । चूँकि भगवान्‌ सर्वव्यापी हैं, अतएव सर्वत्र तथा सदैव उनका गुणगान अनिवार्य है ।

They have already mentioned in the previous verse that, in addition to the grand method of devotion, there is no auspicious way to attain salvation.
There is no other way. By devotees, various methods such as listening, chanting, remembrance, serving the feet, worship, bowing, servitude, friendship,
and self-dedication, the practice of Bhakti Yoga is done. These are the nine authentic methods.
A devoted devotee can obtain the desired result through all, some, or only one of these methods. But among these,
the first method, that is, the method of listening, is the most important in Bhakti Yoga. Without listening with sufficient and appropriate methods, no progress can be made through the practice of other methods, and only for listening,
the entire Vedic literature is filled, which has been compiled by the powerful incarnation of God like Vyasadeva. Since it has been ensured that God is the Supreme Being of every object, therefore their
listening and chanting should be everywhere and always. This is a human’s unique duty.
When a man
stops listening about the omnipresent God, then he becomes accustomed to listening to garbage broadcast by man-made instruments. No instrument is bad, because through the instrument, man can listen to God's
subject, but by being used for hidden purposes, the instrument is bringing about an accelerated decline in the level of human civilization. Here it is said that it is essential for a human to listen, because
Bhagavad Gita and Srimad Bhagavat, such texts are written with this objective. Besides humans, no other
living being can listen to such Vedic texts. If human society listens to Vedic literature,
then it will not be able to hear the impure words uttered by those impure people who are lowering the entire
society's level. Listening is done through the Positive Kirtan. The person who listens from a proper source
becomes assured about the omnipresent God, and then he is encouraged to sing the praises of God.
All the great teachers, such as Ramanuja, Madhva, Chaitanya, Saraswati,
Thakur, or in other countries, Muhammad, Jesus, and others, have always and everywhere praised God through kirtan.
They have sung the praises of God. Since God is omnipresent, His praise is necessary everywhere and always. There should be no restrictions of country and time in praising God. This is Sanatan Dharma or
Bhagwat Dharma is called. The meaning of Sanatan is eternal, always and WIAA. The meaning of Bhagwat is God
